title: 第156章 人应该怎么学会面对离别呢
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

三公结束退场时，VaX和林石还是被人拍到了。

当时，VaX沉默地和林石并排走着，准备穿过一条长廊回地下停车场。

林石一路上都在低头回复消息，眉头始终皱紧。

“怎么了？”VaX悄悄看了一眼林石难看的脸色，隐隐有预感和战队有关。

埋头打字的林石抽空看了他一眼，随即敷衍回复：“没什么大事，今晚小替补洗澡摔了一跤，现在得临时在联盟找个选手顶一场。”

闻言，VaX表情瞬间一片空白：“哈？？”

这不是大事吗？？

他当即掏出手机，点进今晚一直没看的RXG内部群，果然发现已经炸开了锅。

小替补在群里发了个【哭哭】的表情，安抚担忧又抓狂人：【没事，休息一场差不多就行。】

VaX看着群里飞速刷屏的聊天页面，对RXG最近的运势感到深深地忧虑。

“林哥，要不我们找个庙拜拜吧？”他难过地肘了一下身侧的林石。

林石无语地瞥他一眼，语气倒是很实诚：“有道理。”

“要不是ZPL规定赛季中只有一次将青训选手临时提上一队的机会，也不会这么被动了。”林石叹了口气，眉眼间满是愁绪。

VaX眼睛滴溜一转，状似不经意地开口：“哎对了，江那边三公完会放假吗？”

林石又叹了口气：“我知道你什么意思，但是不行的，让你江哥安心休息吧。”

这时，身侧突然传来一声惊呼：“VaX？？”

冷不防被喊了声名字的VaX身体一僵，条件反射地驻足朝发声方向看去。

不看还好，一看更是直接坐实了他的身份。

长廊里零星的几个人听到这个名字，纷纷敏感地停下脚步，向两人看去。

这下，几乎所有在场的人都认出了RXG的选手和经理。

“我去？VaX和林石？他们怎么在这？”

“来看江执屿的？”

“有道理，不过过两天不是有比赛吗？还有空来看公演？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When San Gong finished and left the stage, VaX and Lin Shi were still photographed.

At that time, VaX was walking side by side with Lin Shi in silence, preparing to walk through a long corridor back to the underground parking lot.

Lin Shi lowered his head to reply to messages along the way, his brows furrowed all the time.

"What's wrong?" VaX quietly glanced at Lin Shi's ugly face, and had a vague feeling that it had something to do with the team.

Lin Shi, who was immersed in typing, took a moment to glance at him and then replied perfunctorily: "It's nothing serious. The substitute fell down in the shower tonight. Now I have to find a player from the league to take over."

Hearing this, VaX's expression instantly went blank: "Huh??"

Isn't this a big deal??

He immediately took out his mobile phone and clicked into the RXG internal group that he hadn't watched tonight, and sure enough he found that it had exploded.

The little substitute posted a [crying] emoji in the group to reassure worried and frantic people: [It's okay, just take a break.】

VaX looked at the rapidly scrolling chat pages in the group and felt deeply worried about RXG's recent fortune.

"Brother Lin, how about we find a temple to worship?" He elbowed Lin Shi beside him sadly.

Lin Shi glanced at him speechlessly, and his tone was very sincere: "It makes sense."

"If ZPL hadn't stipulated that there was only one opportunity to temporarily put youth training players into the first team during the season, I wouldn't be so passive." Lin Shi sighed, his eyebrows full of sadness.

VaX's eyes rolled, and he said casually: "Oh, by the way, will the three gentlemen on the other side of the river have a holiday?"

Lin Shi sighed again: "I know what you mean, but if it doesn't work, let your Brother Jiang rest in peace."

At this moment, a cry suddenly came from beside me: "VaX??"

VaX's body stiffened when his name was called unexpectedly, and he reflexively stopped and looked in the direction of the sound.

It's okay not to look at it, but once you look at it, his identity is immediately confirmed.

When a few people in the corridor heard the name, they stopped sensitively and looked at the two of them.

At this time, almost everyone present recognized the players and managers of RXG.

"Shall I go? VaX and Lin Shi? Why are they here?"

"Come to see Jiang Zhiyu?"

"It makes sense, but isn't there a competition in two days? Are you still free to watch the performance?"
